title: 2 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Vina Robles Amphitheatre, Paso Robles, California
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Vina Robles Amphitheatre in Paso Robles, California, USA, on 2 October 2015.

It was the 19th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

On the plane leaving for LA another great night this is the best band in the land peace and love ??????? pic.twitter.com/SruxCSaZsq

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 3, 2015

Starr returned to the Vina Robles Amphitheatre on 31 August 2019, 16 June 2023, and 6 June 2026.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
